name: Firbolg
body:
Firbolgs are among the smallest of all giants—as well as the most inscrutable.

Friends to the fey, they are reclusive and skilled at trickster magic.

Physical

The largest firbolgs stand just over 8 feet tall with wide, stout builds, and are considered Large in size.

While these larger firbolgs live out in the open and are thus more likely to be seen, they are actually a minority among firbolgs.

Most firbolgs are under 8 feet tall and have a more slender build, causing them to be treated as Medium creatures.

Firbolgs prefer to conceal their true appearance when among other humanoids, and this is especially true of the smaller, more reclusive ones. Their true appearance is not too dissimilar from that of humans, except that their skin and hair come in a great deal more different shades. Pink blonde, brown, and bright red hair are all common, while their skin may be mauve, light green, sky-blue, or lavender, in addition to all of the skin colors typical for humans.

Social

Most firbolgs keep to themselves and have little interaction with others. They build small, sheltered villages in remote forests and mountains, where they can live at peace in quiet harmony with nature. Many such communities regularly interact with local fey and magical beasts, whose company they enjoy. On the rare occasion that they do need to cross paths with humanoids, they get along best with elves, gnomes, and rougarou, but will go out of their way to avoid humans, orcs, and most other species of giants.

Although they have a reputation for being shy, firbolgs are fierce warriors with the instincts of giants. When pressed, they are capable of defending themselves with both arms and magic.

Alignment and Religion

Firbolgs are usually Neutral in alignment.

Some prioritize their individuality and lean toward Chaotic alignments. Meanwhile, very few place their own interests above those of their community and forest to pursue the path of Evil.

Most firbolgs practice some form of the druidic faith, although some prefer shamanic practices or another form of religion. Regardless, all have a deep, spiritual connection with nature.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are physically strong and mentally calm, but not quick to react. Your ability score adjustments are +2 Str, +2 Wis, –2 Dex [standard].
Size Medium. As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size.
Type You are a Humanoid with the giant subtype.
Speed Normal. Your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Giant. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Elven, Gnome, Rougarou, Sylvan, and Treant.
Alternate Traits
Low-Light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.
Powerful Build Your physical stature allows you to function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Whenever you are subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a Combat Maneuver Bonus or Combat Maneuver Defense (such as during grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), you are treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to you. You are also considered to be one size larger when determining the damage of your unarmed strikes, and when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect you. You can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty. However, your space and reach remain those of a creature of your actual size. The benefts of this species trait stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change your size category.
Spell-Like Abilities You can use detect magic, disguise self, know direction, speak with animals once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.
Skilled You gain a +2 species bonus on Handle Animal and Stealth checks.
Alternate Species Traits
Cunning You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (nature) checks made to identify creatures of the fey type, to Perception checks made to notice a disguise, and to Spellcraft checks. This trait replaces skilled.
Fey Blessed You have a particularly strong relationship with the fey, and they have blessed you with quickness of both wit and body. Your ability score adjustments are +2 Str, +2 Cha, –2 Wis. In addition, you receive Fleet as a bonus feat and a +2 species bonus to saving throws against charm and compulsion effects. This trait alters ability scores and replaces powerful build.
Large You come from one of the tribes of firbolgs that are bigger and burlier than most. Your size is Large, and you gain a further +2 bonus to Strength and a –2 penalty to Dexterity. (If you have the standard firbolg ability scores, this makes your net ability score adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Wis, –4 Dex.) Your reach remains 5 feet. This trait alters size and replaces powerful build.
Mischief Magic You can use lesser confusion, reduce person, and unwitting ally once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability. This trait replaces spell-like abilities.
Plant Whisperer You can use entangle and speak with plants once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability. This trait replaces spell-like abilities.
Powerful Athlete You gain a +2 species bonus to Climb checks. In addition, you are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump. This trait replaces skilled.
Spell Resistance You possess spell resistance equal to 6 plus your character level. This trait replaces powerful build.
Stealth Magic You can use ghost sound, pass without trace, and vanish once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability. This trait replaces spell-like abilities.
Wanderer You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (geography) and Survival checks. This trait replaces skilled.
Favored Class Bonuses
Bard Add +1/2 on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and +1/2 on Disguise checks to appear as an elf, half-elf, or human.
Cleric Add +1/2 to your channeled energy total when healing creatures of the animal, fey, and plant types.
Druid Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks relating to fey, and a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence magical beasts.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or dirty trick attempt.
Hunter Add DR 1/magic to your animal companion. Each time you select this benefit again, the DR increases by +1/2 (maximum DR 10/magic). If you replace your animal companion, the new companion gains this damage reduction.
Oracle Add +1 spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level oracle spell you can cast.
Paladin Add +1/2 hit point to your lay on hands ability (whether using it to heal or harm).
Ranger Add a +1/2 bonus to wild empathy checks.
Rogue Add +1 to the number of times per day you can cast a cantrip or 1st-level spell gained from the minor magic or major magic talent. The number of times this bonus is selected for the major magic talent cannot exceed the number of times it is selected for the minor magic talent. You must possess the associated rogue talent to select these options.
Shaman Add one spell from the druid spell list to your shaman spell list. This spell must be at least 1 spell level lower than the highest-level shaman spell you can cast.
Sorcerer Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. Adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.
Summoner Add +1 skill rank to your eidolon.
Witch Add +1 spell from the witch spell list to your familiar. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level witch spell you can cast. If you ever replace your familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
